title: WindPrompt - Professional AI Prompt Library
shortDescription: A platform for sharing and discovering high-quality prompts for AI image generation tools. Features an integrated admin system, traffic analytics, and optimal affiliate tools.

overview.summary: WindPrompt (https://windprompt.com/) is a curated library of the most trending and optimized prompts for AI image generation models. The project not only provides a smooth search and copy experience for end users but also features a comprehensive Admin Dashboard to measure performance and integrate monetization tools.
overview.background: As AI image generation becomes increasingly popular, users often struggle to find a prompt that yields the desired results. WindPrompt was built to address this need, creating a space where users can easily access high-quality prompts, while allowing administrators to easily manage content and track performance.

challenge.title: Building a Smooth Experience & Efficient Data Management
challenge.problem: The biggest challenge was building a platform that displays a large number of high-quality images with their prompts without slowing down page load speeds, while simultaneously developing an Admin system robust enough to track key engagement metrics.
bottlenecks: Optimizing performance to render mass AI images and handle fast search and filtering.
Building a tracking system for critical metrics like Pageviews, prompt Copy rate, and user geographical location.
Designing a flexible data structure to support multiple languages and integrate monetization/affiliate modules without bothering users.

solution.title: Modern Web Architecture & Comprehensive Admin System
solution.approach: Using Next.js combined with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM to ensure fast response times and SEO optimization. The interface is designed to be modern, visual-first, and minimizes user interactions.
keyInnovations: Visual discovery feature: Displays the top 20 trending prompts and a library categorized by various topics.
Comprehensive Admin page: Provides a visual statistics Dashboard of total users, views, copy rates, and traffic graphs by country.
Flexible Monetization integration: Allows administrators to easily add and customize Affiliate tags from the settings page.

architecture.overview: A clearly layered modern web system prioritizing high performance and scalability.

layers.detail: Responsive design supporting quick view and 1-click copy features. Optimized image loading and grid-based list display.
Handles category filtering logic, records user events (copy, view), and returns statistical data for the Dashboard.
Stores Prompt information, access analytics data, system configuration information, and user data.

features.title: Prompt Library & Trend Discovery
features.description: The main interface allows users to browse the most prominent prompts. Supports search, categorization, and a 'Top 20' trending prompt leaderboard.
technicalHighlights: Instant image preview and prompt copying operations.

features.title: Admin Dashboard & Traffic Management
features.description: A dedicated control center for administrators, providing real-time data on site activity.
technicalHighlights: Analytical charts for Pageviews and copy rate statistics.
Tracking visitors by country (Singapore, UK, Canada, etc.).

features.title: Affiliate Tool Integration (Monetization)
features.description: A system allowing flexible creation and management of affiliate marketing ads without affecting SEO or user experience.
technicalHighlights: Customizable Affiliate tags in the Sidebar or below Prompts.
System-wide toggle to Enable/Disable monetization mode with a single click.

takeaways: Building a content sharing platform requires a balance between the end-user experience (smooth, easy to use) and tools for the administrator (detailed, easily configurable).
Integrating an analytics system and monetization tools from the start helps the project be self-sustaining and well-oriented for future expansion.
